title: What is best practice for training intensity and duration distribution in endurance athletes?
journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance

keyFinding.enGB: Describes a common ~80/20 easy-to-hard intensity distribution among endurance athletes as a training-organisation pattern, not a universal prescription.
